articleTitle: How to Stop Regretting Every Choice You've Made
imageHeadline: Stop treating every choice like proof you can't decide
imageSubtext: Break the regret loop and rebuild confidence in your judgment
pinTitle: How to Stop Regretting Every Choice You've Made | Breaking the Chronic Regret Loop
pinDescription: When regret becomes your default response to past decisions—school, jobs, relationships—it stops being about any single choice and starts eroding your confidence as a decision-maker. Learn the difference between productive regret and rumination, why fear of future regret keeps you stuck, and how to shift from second-guessing to learning.

items.label: Ask what you learned, not what you should have known
Separate the decision from the outcome
Notice when fear of regret is driving choices
